Maskína's July 2021 report (PDF modified 6 Aug 2021): "Könnunin fór fram dagana 13. til 26. júlí 2021 og voru svarendur 847 talsins" (847 is the row's n); its D 20,9, V 14,1, S 13,7, P 12,7, C 12,3, B 9,9, J 6,3, M 5,5 and F 4,5 are the row's shares before the data's 1% Annað. Wikipedia's 2021 page dates the poll "July 2021" only, which gave the row its later end of 31 Jul

mbl.is, 6 Sep 2021: "Könnunin var gerð dagana 31. ágúst til 3. september og var leitað álits 957 manna"; its D 24,9, B 13,3, S 12,1 and V 10,8 are the row's, and 957 is the row's n. Wikipedia's 2021 page has no row for this poll. Published on 6 Sep, two days after end + 1

maskina.is, 8 Sep 2021: "Könnunin fór fram dagana 31. ágúst til 6. september 2021", with 2078 svarendur (the row's n). The linked report (2021_09_Stöð2_FylgiFlokka-1.pdf) gives D 23,9, V 12,5, S 12,3, C 11,7, B 11,5, P 11,2, J 7,9, F 4,5 and M 4,5: the row's shares without its 1% Annað. Its kjördæmi table is the kjördæmi poll of the same date, which takes this end as its national twin. Wikipedia's 2021 page has no row for this poll

Heimildin, 30 May 2024: "Könnunin var gerð daganna 30. apríl til 23. maí 2024 og svarendur voru 3.349 talsins" (the row's n is 3,350); its D 17,5 and S 27,3 are the row's shares before the data's 1% Annað. The data dates the poll at its fieldwork end, so Wikipedia's 30 Apr–23 May 2024 row, with its midpoint 11.5 days earlier, does not match
RÚV, 5 Oct 2024: "Könnun Prósents fór fram dagana 18. september til 3. október"; its shares are the row's (S 26, M 18, D 12, F 11, C 11, P 9, B 5, J 4, V 3)
